# Country scope: 1 once the country has an ageing carrier (the market threshold starts; te_demog_lx_market_fall).
te_demog_lx_country_carrier = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_technology_researched = biological_immortality
				has_technology_researched = genetic_engineering
				has_technology_researched = mrna_therapeutics
				has_technology_researched = personalized_medicine
				has_technology_researched = synthetic_biology
			}
		}
		value = 1
	}
}

# Country scope: the medical diffusion type's technologies and the World Health Organization's convention (at the
# strength its modifier carries), which speed the market threshold's fall (the decree, one state's, is left out).
te_demog_lx_market_diffusion = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_technology_researched = electric_telegraph } add = 0.05 }
	if = { limit = { has_technology_researched = modern_nursing } add = 0.05 }
	if = { limit = { has_technology_researched = radio } add = 0.05 }
	if = { limit = { has_technology_researched = telemedicine } add = 0.05 }
	if = { limit = { has_technology_researched = world_wide_web } add = 0.05 }
	if = {
		limit = { je:je_united_nations ?= { has_modifier = un_pandemic_cooperation_modifier } }
		add = {
			value = 0.05
			multiply = un_convention_multiplier
		}
	}
}

# State scope (late-game §3.5): State Youth Centers' levels on the ectogenesis method, once the owner has its
# technology (the buildings aren't walked before).
te_demog_lx_ecto_levels = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { owner ?= { has_technology_researched = biotechnology } }
		every_scope_building = {
			limit = {
				is_building_type = building_state_youth_centers
				has_active_production_method = pm_ectogenesis
			}
			add = level
		}
	}
}
